shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Cross-level combat, senses, NPC travel, CE bridge (experimental), "Traveler" climb animations, blueprint art, wall risers, research-gated links, a per-colony off switch, Perspective Shift + Toggleable Overlays support. Window 11 SHIPPED to Workshop 3776015553, fully field-verified. Now in build mode, window 12 open.
body:
**NOTE TO SELF:** running spec, not a changelog. §0 handover; §1-19 architecture; §20 compat; §21-29 bug records; §30 SUPERSEDED by §62; §31 publishing + GIT; §32-40 records; §41-44 combat/senses/travel/CE; §51 Celestial Lighting; §52 field-report round 2; §53 arrival/landing; §54 structure fit; §55 exit grid; §56 Geological Landforms; §57 stale decoration window; §58 relocated-structure fog; §59 forbid-aware islands; §60 area-linear vanilla systems; §61 camera-mod coexistence; §62 utility COLUMN rework + §62.N; §63 stairs permission; §64 cross-level shadow depth; §65 forbidden mirroring; §66 aim/wild-miss/aim-pie; §67 boulder extrusion; §68 KCSG/VFEM2; §69 stair temperature; §70 band flora legality + §70.B (OPEN); §71 Smooth Terrain (RESOLVED; report awaiting paste); §72 link gizmos; §73 transit animations (SUPERSEDED); §74 blueprint art; §75 wall risers; §76 Perspective Shift; §77 motion study + §77b railing bug + §77c art defects; §78 pre-hop delay + climb grammar; §79 Toggleable Overlays; §80 research gating; §81 multiple-levels checkbox. **§78-§81 ALL SHIPPED AND FIELD-VERIFIED.** Keep every ⚠. # As above, So below II (V2) > **⚠⚠ V1 SOURCE IS NOT GONE. DATED SOURCE BACKUPS LIVE AT `D:\Rimworld\As above, So below\\Source\`** (ten snapshots, newest `20260726-154207`). The old note "V1 survives only in git history pre-a50a744" was WRONG and cost a re-derivation. These are `Source/` only - no Defs, no Textures. **When a V2 feature has a V1 ancestor, READ THE V1 FILE FIRST.** Confirmed useful: `Source/Stairs/ClimbAnimation.cs` (§78d). Tool boundary: `read` refuses that path, `bash`/`grep`/`sed` reach it fine. # 0. START HERE **CURRENT PHASE: BUILD MODE, WINDOW 12 OPEN. NOTHING IS IN FLIGHT.** **WINDOW 11 IS SHIPPED** to Workshop 3776015553 and was the cleanest window yet: **all four features field-verified before upload, zero bridge errors across both runs, nothing shipped blind.** §80/§81 verified run #373; §78d/§79 verified run #374 (Toggleable Overlays loaded as a companion, 4-band map). Pushed as **`93a8311`**; the six stripped items are **restored** and the post-restore build is green (0w/0e), which proves the move lost nothing. Staging dir removed. **⚠ WORKSPACE DLL IS A DEBUG BUILD AGAIN** (the post-restore verification build). Re-run `dotnet build -c Release` in `Source/` before any publish. **⚠ THE ONE THING WINDOW 11 DID NOT DO: THE WORKSHOP SMOKE TEST.** Still never done for any window. Every verification to date has been against the WORKSPACE copy; nobody has ever subscribed to the uploaded item and loaded it. That is the one class of fault this project is structurally blind to - a file that exists locally but was never uploaded would pass every check made so far. **⚠ OPEN, NOT URGENT:** **FINAL riser art** (Gemini PAUSED r5; ⚠ REWRITE prompts to the REAL palette - NO copper: power=steel+blue+hazard, pipe=pale+red valve, climate=ice+louver+orange, data=black+purple+cyan; the 12 shipped riser PNGs are placeholders by explicit user decision). **§77c ART** - grand staircase east/west sprites unrotated; user's domain. **ABOUT.XML DESCRIPTION IS STALE** (no research gating, no off switch; "You pick the shape at colony start" is now also "or no levels at all") - USER'S COPY, flagged not fixed. **`About/known-issues.json`** has shipped unchanged since window 8 and nobody has confirmed it is meant to. **⚠ SHIPPED KNOWINGLY UNVERIFIED (earlier windows, still true):** §62.N, §70 (w8); §62.M, §66c, §66e (w7). **⚠ USER WORKING RULES:** (1) NEVER source design ideas from other mods unless asked - scans COMPAT ONLY. **V1 is OUR OWN prior work and is exempt: porting from it is explicitly wanted.** (2) Building art = USER via Nano Banana kits. (3) About.xml description = USER's copy. (4) N mockups = N CHOICES. **What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: visual clarity from above, performance, vanilla parity. **⚠⚠ THE FORTY-NINE RULES:** 1. CLAMP AT SELECTION. 2. NEVER PATCH `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms`. 3. REGION CONNECTIVITY IS MORE OPTIMISTIC THAN THE PATHFINDER: flood CELLS. 4. COUNT EMITTERS/POPULATIONS/ENGINE STACKS. 5 (§48): A `Touch` TARGET IS USUALLY UNWALKABLE. 6 (§49): A VANILLA HELPER CAN BE A NO-OP INSTEAD OF AN ERROR. 7 (§52): THE CARVE IS NOT THE LAST WORD. 8 (§52.6): A LOAD-TIME REPAIR PASS MUST NEVER RE-CREATE WHAT THE PLAYER DELIBERATELY REMOVED. 9 (§53): SOME MISPLACEMENTS ARE NOT VISIBLE IN THE CELL. 10 (§54): A STRUCTURE IS NOT A CELL. 11 (§55): A CELL-LEVEL VERDICT CANNOT AUTHORIZE A PAWN-LEVEL ACTION. 12 (§56a): A FOREIGN MOD'S MAP-SIZE SNAPSHOT IS AN INPUT YOU CAN CORRECT. 13 (§56g): NEVER COPY A GRID YOU DID NOT WATCH BEING WRITTEN. 14 (§56m): BEFORE RELOCATING DATA, ASK WHAT IS ALREADY AT THE DESTINATION. 15 (§57i): ASSERT ALWAYS, NARRATE ON REQUEST. 16 (§56o): COUNT THE FOREIGN MOD'S WRITE PATHS. 17 (§56q): A PASSING RUN THAT DID NOT REPRODUCE THE FAILURE IS NOT A FIX. 18 (§57a): NEVER EXONERATE A SUSPECT ON ONE CLEAN SAMPLE. 19 (§57f): `TicksGame` RESTARTS AT 0 EVERY NEW GAME. 20 (§57g): MOVING WORK EARLIER TURNS ON EVERY "IS THIS MAP READY" GATE. 21 (§58): THE PARALLEL GRIDS DO NOT TRAVEL WITH THE CONTENT. 22 (§59): A DERIVED GRID HAS NO PAWN IN IT. 23 (§60): AUDIT THE WEIGHTING, NOT THE SYMBOL. 24 (§61a): CLAMPING A VALUE WITHOUT CLAMPING ITS TARGET BUILDS AN OSCILLATOR. 25 (§61b): A POSTFIX ON `Update` IS AFTER THE OBJECT WAS ALREADY POSITIONED. 26 (§61f): EVERY READ OF THE MAP THE PLAYER CAN REACH MUST PASS THE RENDERER'S "IS IT DRAWN" GATE. 27 (§62c): PREFER SPAWN/DESPAWN OVER FLICK. 28 (§63a): A PERMANENT FICTION INSTALLED FOR ONE SUBSYSTEM IS READ AS FACT BY EVERY OTHER ONE. 29 (§0b): REPORT OUTCOMES, NOT INTENTIONS. 30 (§66d): A FELT DURATION IS A CHAIN, NOT A NUMBER. 31 (§66f): MAKE THE GUARD SAY WHICH CLAUSE DECLINED. 32 (§69a): TURNING OFF A TICK TURNS OFF EVERY SERVICE THAT RODE ON IT. 33 (§62k): A FILTER THAT CAN REJECT EVERYTHING MUST SAY SO. 34 (§62l): AN INVISIBLE THING IS ABSENT FROM EVERY SECTION LAYER. 35 (§62n): A CLONED FOREIGN DEF MADE VISIBLE IS IN NONE OF THE HOST'S OWN LOOKUPS. 36 (§70a): RUN VANILLA'S OWN LEGALITY PREDICATE. 37 (§71a): NAME THE ENFORCEMENT POINT BEFORE NAMING THE SYMPTOM. 38 (§73): WHEN A SPRITE MUST APPEAR AWAY FROM ITS THING'S POSITION, OWN THE DRAW. 39 (§76): WINNING THE LAST WRITE DOES NOT SETTLE A DISAGREEMENT ABOUT THE TARGET. 40 (§75.h): A TRIPWIRE THAT FIRES BEFORE THE OBSERVER ATTACHES IS NOT A TRIPWIRE. 41 (§77a): A STRUCT FIELD YOU NEVER SET IS A FEATURE YOU NEVER SHIPPED. 42 (§77b): THE DIRECTION A MOTION READS AS IS A PROPERTY OF THE THING, NOT OF THE ARRIVAL - and the far end is a DIFFERENT thing with its own axis. 43 (§78): **DEFER THE MOVE, NEVER THE DECISION.** 44 (§78b): AN OFFSET APPLIED WHOLE ON FRAME ONE IS A TELEPORT, AND EVERY `DrawPos`-DERIVED OVERLAY STAYS BEHIND. 45 (§78d): **A DIRECTION OF TRAVEL IS NOT A DIRECTION OF ELEVATION.** 46 (§78d): **NON-UNIFORM SCALE x ROTATION = SHEAR.** Squash-and-stretch OR lean, never both. 47 (§79): **A FOREIGN MOD'S CACHED CURSOR CELL IS AN ASSUMPTION ABOUT COORDINATE SPACE.** Substitute the cell around our pass instead of re-patching its N gates. 48 (§81a): **A WRITE THAT IS READ BACK BY ITS OWN CALLER IS NOT A WRITE.** `Window.WindowOnGUI` does `windowRect = GUI.Window(ID, windowRect, ...)` - it passes the old rect in and assigns the result back AFTER the callback, so a windowRect set from inside `DoWindowContents` is clobbered in the same frame with no error. 49 (§0c): **A TEST THAT PROVES FEATURE A SAYS NOTHING ABOUT FEATURE B, AND "TESTS GOOD" IS NOT A SCOPE.** Run #373 verified §80/§81 and, by generating the single-level map the §81 script asked for, structurally could not touch §78d; §79 could not have run at all because Toggleable Overlays was not in the session. Name the features a run exercised, at the time, and check the MODLIST before believing a compat feature was covered. --- # WINDOW 12 LEDGER (open) 1. **⚠ WORKSHOP SMOKE TEST** of the window-11 upload, from the WORKSHOP copy. Highest value item here: it is the only check nothing else covers. 2. **§78 FOLLOW-ONS, now unblocked because §78 is proven:** **delete the retired ghost stubs** (`IsGhosting` returns constant false, `DrawGhosts` is a no-op, both with live call sites in `ABBelowDynamicDraw`); **AnimationDef pipeline port** (V1 drove the climb through native `AnimationDef` + `BaseAnimationWorker` and checked `renderer.CurAnimation` to never stomp a foreign animation - strictly better for compat with Yayo's/Melee Animation; OFFERED, NOT ACCEPTED); hostiles skipping the hold. 3. **⚠ PS NOT RE-TESTED SINCE §78** changed transit timing - run #374 did not load it. Needs `quicktest=false`. 4. **⚠ FOREIGN PRINT-PATH AUDIT.** **RimIOT and Eccentric Tech have never been decompiled.** Rule 18: showing nothing across runs #330/#340/#346/#347 exonerates neither. Decompile each, find the print entry point, add a `Hosts` row if thing-side, PROVE it with `AB2: carrier probe`'s patch census. 5. **§62.N FORMAL LINE.** `AB2: network scan` → `PipeSystem: bound=N ... | skip: (none)`. 6. **§70 FIELD VERIFY** (Biomes! Caverns; mud bare = CORRECT). **§70.B still OPEN.** 7. **§71 Smooth Terrain upstream report** awaiting paste. 8. §75 residue: wall-destroy cascade, pawn + furniture sharing a riser cell. 9. §76 residue (OFFERED, NOT ACCEPTED): PS's `UpdateLeanTarget` uses raw `GenSight`; PS's melee branch is a bare `DistanceTo <= 1.42f` with no band test. 10. **§79.4 ON THE SHELF:** TO's blueprint slider defaults to 1.0 and we adopt it, so a TO user who never opens TO's settings gets opaque plans. Field-checked and accepted; one line reverses it if a report lands - `Mathf.Min(theirs, DefaultBlueprintAlpha)`. 11. **§80 residue:** research row 6.40 is ours only until a DLC extends the tree downward; the four projects have no `iconPath`/`ResearchTabDef`. **§80.4:** tribal starts begin with no vertical link - watch for reports; one `
  • TribalStart
    • ` reverses it. 12. **§77 unused idea worth revisiting:** mockup D's structure-animation track (the building reacts to a crossing), orthogonal to what shipped. 13. §64; §65; §61; §60/59/58/55/54/53; §56.1; DATA network thin. **DCH: add a `Hosts` row if a user runs DubsCentralHeating.** **⚠ TEST-LOOP NOTES:** palette pins resolve during map init - use the Debug Actions MENU for `PlayingOnMap` actions. **PS runs, and anything touching the advanced-config dialog (§81), need `quicktest=false`.** **Startup warnings never reach the bridge.** **`build_mod` builds DEBUG.** **⚠ CHECK `Mod_50b4332c2547_ABMod.xml` IN THE TEST SAVEDATA BEFORE A BANDED-MAP RUN:** Scribe omits defaults, so an ABSENT `multiLevel` node means TRUE; a previous §81 test can leave it FALSE and hand you a stairless map. ⚠ Long `newText` blocks in the edit tool have truncated mid-string three times; for big block replacements write a temp file and splice with python, and **write the temp file inside the mod folder** - bash `/tmp` is not visible to python3. **⚠ KNOWN-BENIGN FOREIGN NOISE:** VFEM2 TorchWallLamp MakeThing error; Rimefeller `discord.dds` `f2fab05fc732a605`; Rimefeller `CompOilDerrick.setfull` NRE (`#fc35ef297211de6b`). NONE ARE OURS. --- # 1-30 — unchanged. # 31. PUBLISHING — `docs/PUBLISH_CHECKLIST.md` IS AUTHORITATIVE Strip = SIX moves (`Source/`, `Tools/`, `docs/`, `.git/`, `mockups/`, `.gitignore`) to a staging dir OUTSIDE `Mods/`; the utility pushes FILES + PREVIEW ONLY, so change notes and description go into the Steam **web** editor by hand. Commit and push BEFORE the strip. **⚠ `.gitignore` travels with `.git/`** and was caught in the ship list once (window 9). **⚠ THE WINDOW-11 RUN OF THIS PROCEDURE, WHICH WORKED AND IS WORTH REPEATING VERBATIM:** release build → log-hygiene grep over every `Log.Message` site → metadata check → write `UPDATE_NOTES.txt` and grep it for em-dashes (house rule) → commit and push → strip the six with a loop that PRINTS each move and says ABSENT for anything missing → `find` the ship list for `obj`/`bin`/`*.pdb`/`*.csproj`/`*.cs`/`0Harmony.dll` → publish → restore with the same loop → **rebuild to prove the restore lost nothing** → commit "shipped". Record the staging path in §0 while stripped: a session that opens on a stripped folder has no `Source/`, no git and no checklist, and no way to find out why. # 32-72 — unchanged. # 73 SUPERSEDED BY §78. # 74. BLUEPRINT ART — SHIPPED w10, USER-VERIFIED `ABBlueprintLook` retint; `Blueprint_ABBuild` stuff tint; `ABGhostGraphicForLinks` IsDoor bypass. Single knob, consumed in TWO places (blueprint `GraphicData.color` AND `Blueprint_ABBuild.DrawColor`, which must re-apply it over the stuff colour or a stuffed plan comes back opaque). **§74.b:** 0.70 read as ALREADY BUILT; now **0.42**. **⚠ §74.c: THE KNOB IS NO LONGER A CONST.** `DefaultBlueprintAlpha` = 0.42 is the fallback; `BlueprintAlpha` is a mutable static driven by `ApplyAlpha(float)`, which also rewrites each retinted def's `GraphicData.color` and NULLS `GraphicData.cachedGraphic` (nothing public invalidates it). Stuffed links need none of that - `Blueprint_ABBuild.DrawColor` reads the field per draw. # 75. WALL RISERS — SHIPPED w10, USER-VERIFIED, PLACEHOLDER ART 4 defs; a riser IS a `Building_ABColumn`; WallLamp attachment; no `holdsRoof`; cascade despawn. uiOrder: links 2060-2066, columns 2070-2073, risers 2080-2083. **§75.g `AB2: carrier probe`** - per-cell drawerType/IsCarrier/ShouldPrint census plus a live Harmony patch census. **Keep this tool.** **§75.h:** Dubwise layers derive from plain `SectionLayer`, declare NO `TakePrintFrom`, print from `Building_Pipe.PrintForGrid`; patched per host, deduped by MethodInfo, prefix INSPECTS the `SectionLayer` argument so unrecognised layers print rather than hide (rule 34). **⚠ §75.f IS PARTLY SUPERSEDED BY §80** - the architect ORDER note stands, the "no researchPrerequisites" note does not. # 76. PERSPECTIVE SHIFT — SHIPPED w10, USER-VERIFIED Suspend `Avatar.UpdateCamera` via a parameterless prefix while the viewed band is not the avatar's (rule 39). On transit, snap the camera and NULL `Avatar.physicsPosition`. Freeze via `State.CameraLockPosition`; `lockedByUs` guards release. Cross-band shooting needed no code: PS gates on `verb.CanHitTarget`, which funnels through our `TryFindShootLineFromTo` patch. **⚠ NOT re-tested since §78** - ledger 3. # 77. MOTION STUDY ROUND 2 — CLOSED. TRAVELER PICKED. Five languages in `mockups/anim-A..E-*.html` over a shared kit. **User picked C - Traveler at 0.30 playback** and asked for the delay to move BEFORE the hop. **D's structure-animation track is the one unused idea worth revisiting** (ledger 12). **⚠ §77a FACING (rule 41).** `PawnDrawParms.facing` is a writable `Rot4` on the struct our GetDrawParms postfix already takes by ref. **⚠ ALPHA: NO.** pawn materials are cutout; alpha needs `PawnRenderFlags.Invisible` → `InvisibilityMatPool.GetInvisibleMat`, a distortion shader with a hard-coded cyan multiply. Scale is the only vanish channel. **§77b THE RAILING BUG, BOTH ENDS.** Every `*_south` sprite has its notch on its **NORTH** edge. **Entry edge = `Opposite(Rotation)`, run direction = `Rotation.FacingCell`.** ⚠ **The counterpart shares this end's `Rotation` and that is load-bearing** (`GenAdj.AdjustForRotation`; `TryCellPairs` pairs cell i to cell i) - **DO NOT FLIP IT**. **⚠ §77c ART DEFECTS - USER'S DOMAIN.** (a) `AB_GrandStairsDown/Up_east`/`_west` are the NORTH composition unrotated. (b) `AB_StairsDown_east/_west` differ in composition and sit 0.42 cells north. (c) `AB_StairsUp_east/_west` have no notch on any edge. (d) `AB_LadderUp_east` is a 0.14-cell sliver drawn 0.30 cells west. `ABStairAnim.ArtOffsets` transcribes these honestly. # 78. PRE-HOP DELAY + THE V1 CLIMB GRAMMAR — SHIPPED w11, FIELD-VERIFIED **Structure.** `Carry` splits into `BeginCrossing` / `TickCrossings` / `CarryNow`. Both teleport sites (tick sweep AND `TryConsumeArrival`) route through it. **⚠⚠ WHY THIS IS NOT RUN #297 (rule 43).** #297 held the pawn by REFUSING AN ARRIVAL, so `PatherArrived` never ran, the leg never completed, the job re-issued `StartPath`, `TrySegment` re-segmented forever. **The DECISION was deferred behind a cosmetic condition.** §78 defers only the POSITION WRITE: the record has already left `pending` and `everSegmented`, so there is no leg to re-segment. Held by **`StopDead()` + `StaggerFor`** - StopDead clears `moving` WITHOUT notifying the JobDriver, so the toil waits and `PatherTick` never re-tests `AtDestinationPosition`. Every exit teleports or abandons; anchor lost → `EndCurrentJob`; job changed → cancel, no teleport; moved off the hold cell → fire early; `MaxHoldTicks` 300 backstops. **Four field rounds, no stuck pawns, no bridge errors.** **§78b (round 1).** The clip is authored about the LINK but nothing put the pawn AT the link. (1) absolute snap → `travelX/travelZ` scaled by pose easing. (2) label postfix on `GenMapUI.LabelDrawPosFor(Thing, float)`; ⚠ delta in SCREEN space, y term subtracts. (3) facing from the actual vector. (4) `EntryCellFor` rewrites the path destination. **§78c (round 2).** The sweep carried any pawn within 3 cells, so the clip began mid-walk. `EntryCellFor` now returns the footprint cell just inside the notch - ⚠ tested with **`Walkable`, not `Standable`** (a `Building_Door` is `PassThroughOnly`). ⚠⚠ Narrowing the carry condition has jammed stairwells every previous time, so it is **delayed, never denied**: three triggers (on the cell / stopped short / 120-tick backstop). **§78d (round 3), PORTED FROM V1 `Source/Stairs/ClimbAnimation.cs`:** SLIDE toward centre capped 1.35; BOB on TICKS (period 12/16, amp 0.05/0.08); **VERT z −0.35 down / +0.30 up**, the actual fix; SCALE ×0.72 / ×1.10, **uniform**; LEAN `Sin(t*PI/24)*3°` stairs only; EMERGE 22 ticks ease-out, vertical INVERTED against the climb; durations 90 (ladder 110, elevator 90 + 16/level capped 130). # 79. TOGGLEABLE OVERLAYS — SHIPPED w11, FIELD-VERIFIED Bridge to `Owlchemist.ToggleableOverlays` (ws 3261316725). Reflection-only, no foreign type in any signature, inert and silent when absent. Reads via Harmony `FieldRef`, NOT `FieldInfo.GetValue` - two sit on a per-frame path once profiled at 1.41 ms. **Bound shape:** `ToggleableOverlaysUtility.mousePositionX/mousePositionZ/mousePosition/quickView`; `ModSettings_ToggleableOverlays.hideForbidden/hideForbiddenBuildings/optimizedLister/zoomFilter/blueprintTransparency`; `Mod_ToggleableOverlays.WriteSettings`. The mouse trio is load-bearing; everything else degrades to "that toggle is off". **⚠ 79.1 THE COORDINATE-SPACE BUG (rule 47).** Every one of TO's ~10 gates is `thing.positionInt == mousePosition` against a cell derived from a raw `ScreenPointToRay` - the VIEW band's cell. A below-band thing lives at `z - drop` and can never equal it, so no below overlay is reachable by hover; with TO's defaults that silently deletes stack counts, storage labels, bed names and fuel warnings from every lower level. **Fix = ONE substitution:** `PushBelowMouse` saves their three fields and points them at the cell the hovered column actually shows; `PopMouse` restores in a `finally`. ⚠ Read FROM THEIR OWN FIELDS, not `UI.MouseCell`. ⚠ Off-map/opaque/`drop == 0` parks at `IntVec3.Invalid` (rule 28). ⚠ The `finally` is non-negotiable. **79.2 FORBIDDEN MARKERS.** Our X is a bare `Graphics.DrawMesh` and never enters `RenderForbiddenOverlay` where TO's transpiler lives. `AllowForbiddenBelow` re-implements their check: `quickView` ⇒ true; neither setting ⇒ true; **their zoom gate applies to EVERY category once either setting is on**; `Item` ⇒ cell compare; `Building`/`Ethereal` ⇒ `GenAdj.IsInside`. Settings read LIVE. **79.3 ZOOM CULLING — THEIR SLIDER WINS.** `BelowOverlayGroup` mirrors their `HasGUIOverlay`→`Pawn` swap, falling back to `HasGUIOverlay` when TO is absent or a binding failed. **79.4 BLUEPRINT ALPHA — THEIR SLIDER WINS (rule 39).** Their `WriteSettings` walks every blueprint def and writes `graphic.color.a`, from their static ctor AND on every settings close; racing them is unwinnable, so we ADOPT via a postfix calling `ABBlueprintLook.ApplyAlpha`. **⚠ THEIR SLIDER DEFAULTS TO 1.0**, so a TO user who never opens TO's settings gets fully opaque plans. Accepted; ledger 10. **79.5 NOT BRIDGED, DELIBERATELY.** Their progress-bar/fillable-bar patches gate on the same cursor cell; we never redraw a below-band fillable bar. # 80. RESEARCH GATING — SHIPPED w11, FIELD-VERIFIED Four free-standing `ResearchProjectDef`s, no prerequisites of their own. `AB2_Stairs` (400, Neolithic, ClassicStart) gates stairs up/down **and both grand staircases**; `AB2_Ladders` (400, Neolithic, ClassicStart) gates the ladders; `AB2_TransferColumns` (1200, Industrial) gates the 4 columns **and the 4 wall risers**; `AB2_ElevatorTech` (1600, Industrial) gates the elevator. **80.1 WHERE THE PREREQUISITE IS STATED.** Per-def on `AB2_StairsDown`/`AB2_StairsUp` (their shared `AB2_LinkBase` also parents the ladders and elevator, so a base-level statement would gate all seven on one project), and on the abstract bases `AB2_GrandBase`, `AB2_LadderBase`, `AB_ColumnBase`, `AB_WallRiserBase`. **⚠ 80.2 THE PROJECT IS `AB2_ElevatorTech`, NOT `AB2_Elevator`.** defNames are unique per DefType only, so a project of that name would legally coexist with the ThingDef and make every log line and xpath ambiguous. **⚠ 80.3 THIS PARTLY REVERSES §75.f, AND THE OLD REASONING SURVIVES.** §75.f removed prerequisites because Electricity + Machining locked a fresh colony out of its own utilities until mid game. `AB2_TransferColumns` has NO prerequisites, so that is answered by construction. Per-network toggles still consult each host mod's research (`AB2_ColumnNeedsResearch`). **⚠ The window-10 change notes announced "columns no longer need research"; window 11 walked it back one update later, and the notes say so plainly.** **⚠ 80.4 TRIBAL STARTS BEGIN WITH NO WAY DOWN.** `PlayerColony` lists ClassicStart in `startingResearchTags`; `PlayerTribe` does not. Deliberate, reversible with one `
  • TribalStart
    • `. Ledger 11. **⚠ 80.5 ROW 6.40 IS AN EMPTY ROW TODAY.** Tallest vanilla project across Core + all DLCs is 5.70. # 81. "ENABLE MULTIPLE LEVELS" CHECKBOX — SHIPPED w11, FIELD-VERIFIED A checkbox on the **Levels** heading row of `Dialog_AdvancedGameConfig`, collapsing the bottom strip, backed by scribed `ABSettings.multiLevel` (default true). **81.1 IT SUSPENDS THE PLAN, IT DOES NOT ERASE IT.** `upperLevels`/`lowerLevels` keep the player's choice; `ABMapSizeLimit.MultiLevel` gates only the EFFECTIVE counts, which read 0. `BandCount` collapses to 1 and `Patch_MapGenerator_GenerateMap` takes its pre-existing "single level - ordinary map" branch, so **no new generation path was added**. **81.2 IT ALSO HANDS BACK THE MAP-SIZE COLUMN.** `Active` now includes `MultiLevel`: unticked ⇒ `Fits` unconditional, `Clamp` identity, `BeginChooser` returns before locking or relabelling, the every-frame snap stops. On tick-OFF `mapSize` is forced to **250** or vanilla's radio column comes back with nothing selected. Tick-ON needs no counterpart - `Active` is live and the existing snap clamps onto the ladder the same frame. `AB_MapSizeLockedTip` now opens "Locked by the multiple levels setting:". **⚠ 81.3 THE WINDOW RESIZE (rule 48).** A `windowRect` written from the chooser is clobbered by `windowRect = GUI.Window(ID, windowRect, ...)` in the same frame, silently. The rect is parked in a static and applied by `Patch_Window_ABResizeAfterDraw`, a postfix on base `Window.WindowOnGUI` - on every window's draw path, so its first line is a `ReferenceEquals` bail with nothing allocated above it. (`resizeLater` would work but is gated on `resizeable`, which adds a user-draggable handle.) **⚠ 81.4 LAY OUT AGAINST THE HEIGHT YOU WERE GRANTED.** `InitialSize` is consulted once by `SetInitialSizeAndPosition`, so the checkbox cannot change height by itself. The strip anchors from `GrantedStripHeight`; `WantedStripHeight` is 240 expanded / 44 collapsed; window = `vanilla + granted + StripPadding(48)`. Ticking ON inside a 44px window draws the collapsed row for **one frame** rather than punching through vanilla's columns.
